blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Southeast Asian star Janice Tjen was forced to withdraw from the Singapore Open a day before the main draw kicked off. Tjen, Indonesia’s top player, pulled out on Sunday due to a right wrist injury. The injury didn’t stop her from pushing through with her meet-and-greet at Kallang sports complex on Monday morning. READ: Globetrotting Alex Eala finally ‘closer to home’ at Singapore Open She was supposed to play American Alycia Parks in the first round on Tuesday. Japan’s Mei Yamaguchi has replaced Tjen in the newly upgraded WTA 500 hard-court event. Tjen also had to skip the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games […]...
